question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Beleive"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here we will see the correct spelling of the incorrect one with its meaning:

__
 
• Its*** "Believe"*** and ***"Beleive". ***
 
• **Believe -** to think that something is true, correct, or real
 
 
• ***Eg. ***Strangely, no one* believed* us when we told them we'd been visited by a creature from Mars.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will learn about the other given words:

 
• **Conceive -** to imagine something

 
 
• ***​Eg.*** I think my uncle still* conceives* of me as a four-year-old.
 
 
 
• **​Appropriate -** suitable or right for a particular situation or occasion
 
 
• ***​Eg.*** Is this an *appropriate* occasion to discuss finance?​ 
 
 
 
• **​Terminology -** special words or expressions used in relation to a particular subject or activity
 
 
• ***​Eg. ***Linguists do regret the lack of training that pupils have in such basic grammatical *terminology* and analysis.
